_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Misadventure on the Sea#000.src: Sitting on this stool will start Misadventure on the Sea.
Misadventure on the Sea#000.dst: 坐上这张凳子就会开始“海上历险”。

Misadventure on the Sea#001.src: I'll take two {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#001.dst: 我要两杯 {p} 威士忌。一杯给我，一杯给这位老兄。

Misadventure on the Sea#002.dst: 两杯 {p} 威士忌，马上来！

Misadventure on the Sea#003.src: I'll wait for ya at the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#003.dst: 我在码头等你。别担心，那艘船你不可能错过！

Misadventure on the Sea#005.src: They're a bit too head on, don't you think?
Misadventure on the Sea#005.dst: 他们冲得有点太正面了，你不觉得吗？

Misadventure on the Sea#006.src: I'm tryin' to steer the ship but it's not budging...
Misadventure on the Sea#006.dst: 我在试着转舵，可是船一动也不动……

Misadventure on the Sea#007.src: Sounds like you're being dragged around...
Misadventure on the Sea#007.dst: 听起来像是你被拖着到处跑……

Misadventure on the Sea#008.src: You pick up a small sign...

Misadventure on the Sea#009.dst: 上面写着：“就在你后面，白痴。”

Misadventure on the Sea#010.src: So, there's quite a few bodies in there, and we never bothered throwin' em out!
Misadventure on the Sea#010.dst: 那个，里面有不少尸体，我们一直懒得把它们扔出去！

Misadventure on the Sea#011.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the bodies with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#011.dst: 去吧，这块海绵也给你擦干掉的血迹。直接拿它往尸体上招呼就行！

Misadventure on the Sea#013.src: You take a look inside the furnaces...

Misadventure on the Sea#015.src: An absurd amount of wood shavings, for some reason.
Misadventure on the Sea#015.dst: 一大堆多得离谱的木屑，也不知道为什么。

Misadventure on the Sea#016.src: Looks like the door that leads to the hold...

Misadventure on the Sea#017.src: It's locked. Probably because of the rat issue. Honip must have the key.
Misadventure on the Sea#017.dst: 门锁着。大概是因为老鼠的问题。钥匙应该在 Honip 身上。

Misadventure on the Sea#018.src: You find some notes on the table.
Misadventure on the Sea#018.dst: 你在桌上发现了一些笔记。

Misadventure on the Sea#019.src: There's mentions of... A human cannon? How does that make sense?
Misadventure on the Sea#019.dst: 上面提到……人肉大炮？这说得通吗？

Misadventure on the Sea#020.src: Apparently, only gunpowder is needed, as well as a fuse.
Misadventure on the Sea#020.dst: 看来只需要火药，再加一根导火索。

Misadventure on the Sea#021.src: This cannon is aiming slightly upwards, and it seems less powerful than the others.
Misadventure on the Sea#021.dst: 这门大炮的炮口稍微朝上，威力似乎比其他的弱。

Misadventure on the Sea#022.src: According to the notes you saw, it's probably the "human" cannon. This must be your escape route!
Misadventure on the Sea#022.dst: 根据你看到的笔记，这大概就是那门“人肉”大炮。这一定是你的逃生路线！

Misadventure on the Sea#024.src: There are mentions of a hidden key in the hold...
Misadventure on the Sea#024.dst: 上面提到货舱里藏着一把钥匙……

Misadventure on the Sea#025.src: You should probably search the hold later, when possible.
Misadventure on the Sea#025.dst: 等有机会的时候，你大概该去搜搜货舱。

Misadventure on the Sea#026.src: You cleaned the bodies! You should talk to Honip on the deck.
Misadventure on the Sea#026.dst: 你把尸体都清理干净了！你该去甲板上找 Honip 谈谈。

Misadventure on the Sea#027.src: 'ey! How's the cleaning? Don't forget to check everywhere, ya never know what you might find!
Misadventure on the Sea#027.dst: 嘿！打扫得怎么样？别忘了每个地方都要检查，你永远不知道会找到什么！

Misadventure on the Sea#028.src: You're done? Well good job! Honip's next to the helm if you're lookin' for him.
Misadventure on the Sea#028.dst: 你弄完了？干得好！你要找 Honip 的话，他就在舵轮旁边。

Misadventure on the Sea#029.src: You've been running around the boat for a while now!
Misadventure on the Sea#029.dst: 你已经在船上跑来跑去好一阵子了！

Misadventure on the Sea#031.src: Honip's probably waitin' for ya by now! Take these ladders next to me, he's up there.
Misadventure on the Sea#031.dst: Honip 这会儿大概在等你了！从我旁边这些梯子上去，他就在上面。

Misadventure on the Sea#032.src: If you lose your sponge, Honip can give you a new one on the deck.
Misadventure on the Sea#032.dst: 你要是弄丢了海绵，可以到甲板上找 Honip 再要一块。

Misadventure on the Sea#034.src: Hello there soldier! What can I get you?
Misadventure on the Sea#034.dst: 你好啊，士兵！要来点什么？
Misadventure on the Sea#034.speaker: Barman

Misadventure on the Sea#035.src: I'll take {~} {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#035.dst: 我要 {~} 杯 {p} 威士忌。一杯给我，一杯给这位老兄。
Misadventure on the Sea#035.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#037.src: So... I've seen ya around town. I saw how happy that guy was when you brought him some journal.
Misadventure on the Sea#037.dst: 那个……我在镇上见过你。我看到你把某本日记带给那家伙的时候，他有多开心。
Misadventure on the Sea#037.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#039.src: So... Soldier. Are ya up for sailin' the ocean with me? I got a fancier boat than that seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#039.dst: 那么……士兵。有兴趣跟我一起出海吗？我的船比那个 Seaskipper 的还要气派！
Misadventure on the Sea#039.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#040.src: I figured you'd be interested in explorin' the waters!
Misadventure on the Sea#040.dst: 我就知道你会有兴趣去海上探险！
Misadventure on the Sea#040.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#041.src: I'll wait for ya on the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#041.dst: 我在码头等你。别担心，那艘船你不可能错过！
Misadventure on the Sea#041.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#043.src: There you are! Ready? Follow me, the boat's over here!
Misadventure on the Sea#043.dst: 你来啦！准备好了吗？跟我来，船在这边！
Misadventure on the Sea#043.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#044.src: Look at this.. Magnificent! Much better than whatever the Seaskipper is using!
Misadventure on the Sea#044.dst: 看看这个……真是壮观！比 Seaskipper 用的那些好多了！
Misadventure on the Sea#044.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#045.src: Well, what are you waiting for? Hop aboard!
Misadventure on the Sea#045.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#046.src: Then it's settled, we're goin' on an adventure!
Misadventure on the Sea#046.dst: 那就这么说定了，我们要去冒险啦！
Misadventure on the Sea#046.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#047.src: Buckle up, we got waves to catch.
Misadventure on the Sea#047.dst: 系好安全带，我们要去乘风破浪了。
Misadventure on the Sea#047.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#048.src: So... I should warn ya', this is actually my first time sailing...
Misadventure on the Sea#048.dst: 那个……我得先提醒你，这其实是我第一次开船……
Misadventure on the Sea#048.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#049.src: It doesn't seem too difficult though, a little to the left...
Misadventure on the Sea#049.dst: 不过看起来也不太难，往左一点……
Misadventure on the Sea#049.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#050.src: Hmm, looks like we're not the only ones out on the water today.
Misadventure on the Sea#050.dst: 嗯，看来今天出海的不只我们。
Misadventure on the Sea#050.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#051.src: They are a bit too head on, don't you think?
Misadventure on the Sea#051.dst: 他们冲得有点太正面了，你不觉得吗？
Misadventure on the Sea#051.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#052.src: I'm trying to steer the ship but it's not budging...
Misadventure on the Sea#052.dst: 我在试着转舵，可是船一动也不动……
Misadventure on the Sea#052.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#056.src: I honestly, truly can't believe you fell for that. Let me sum it up for you...
Misadventure on the Sea#056.dst: 说真的，我真不敢相信你会上当。让我帮你总结一下……
Misadventure on the Sea#056.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#057.src: Some extremely suspicious pirate comes up, offers you a drink, and leads you to his suspicious boat.
Misadventure on the Sea#057.dst: 一个超级可疑的海盗走过来，请你喝一杯，然后带你上他那艘可疑的船。
Misadventure on the Sea#057.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#058.src: Any normal person would've turned back by then. But what do you do? You hop on! Well, now you're stuck with us.
Misadventure on the Sea#058.dst: 换作是正常人，早就掉头走了。可你做了什么？你跳上船了！好了，现在你只能跟我们在一起了。
Misadventure on the Sea#058.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#059.src: Let me make this quick. This boat needs renovation, and we want you to do it.
Misadventure on the Sea#059.dst: 我长话短说。这艘船需要整修，我们要你来做。
Misadventure on the Sea#059.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#060.src: Why? You're a soldier! All you do is take orders! Anyway, we'll need you to clean our stuff. Here, get out.
Misadventure on the Sea#060.dst: 为什么？你是士兵啊！你就只会听命令！总之，我们需要你清理我们的东西。来，出去。
Misadventure on the Sea#060.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#062.src: I told you to stay back!
Misadventure on the Sea#062.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#064.src: So, there's quite a few skeletons in there, and we never bothered throwin' them out!
Misadventure on the Sea#064.dst: 那个，里面有不少骷髅，我们一直懒得把它们扔出去！
Misadventure on the Sea#064.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#065.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the skeletons with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#065.dst: 去吧，这块海绵也给你擦干掉的血迹。直接拿它往骷髅身上招呼就行！
Misadventure on the Sea#065.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#066.src: If you need me, I'll be on the deck. And, uh, don't go in the hold. We've got a BIG rat problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#066.dst: 有事的话，我会在甲板上。还有，呃，别进货舱。我们那里有很严重的老鼠问题。
Misadventure on the Sea#066.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#067.src: Also, for the sake of my crew, could you be more cooperative? I don't have an unlimited amount of these potions.
Misadventure on the Sea#067.dst: 还有，为了我的船员着想，你能不能配合一点？这种药水我可没有无限多瓶。
Misadventure on the Sea#067.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#068.src: Clean the bodies in the boat. Look for clues on how to escape at the same time. -Bodies cleaned: #/{~}
Misadventure on the Sea#068.dst: 清理船上的尸体。同时寻找逃脱的线索。-已清理尸体：#/{~}

Misadventure on the Sea#069.src: Hey, so you're our personal guard, huh?
Misadventure on the Sea#069.dst: 嘿，所以你就是我们的专属守卫，是吧？
Misadventure on the Sea#069.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#071.src: That ladder leads to the hold, but right now it's locked... We've got a severe case of rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#071.dst: 那个梯子通往货舱，不过现在锁着……我们的老鼠问题很严重。
Misadventure on the Sea#071.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#072.src: Pep is just a treasure, ain't I right? I'm glad you're taking care of him too!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.dst: Pep 真是个宝贝，你说是不是？我很高兴你也在照顾他！
Misadventure on the Sea#072.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#073.src: Honip has a pet chicken, weird right?
Misadventure on the Sea#073.dst: Honip 养了一只宠物鸡，很怪吧？
Misadventure on the Sea#073.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#074.src: I bet he got inspiration from that weird guy on his island...
Misadventure on the Sea#074.dst: 我打赌他是从他岛上那个怪人那里得到的灵感……
Misadventure on the Sea#074.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#075.src: What? You murdered that guy's most prized chicken? You're an odd one, soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#075.dst: 什么？你杀了那家伙最宝贝的鸡？你真是个怪人，士兵。
Misadventure on the Sea#075.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#076.src: Oh, uh... Don't worry about that, 'ay?
Misadventure on the Sea#076.dst: 噢，呃……那个你别在意，好吗？
Misadventure on the Sea#076.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#078.src: Oh, that's my cannon! Pretty cool, right? I made it using a bunch of arm- Nevermind...
Misadventure on the Sea#078.dst: 噢，那是我的大炮！很酷吧？我是用一堆胳——算了……
Misadventure on the Sea#078.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#080.src: He's a strong chicken alright, trust me on that one.
Misadventure on the Sea#080.dst: 它可是一只强壮的鸡，这点相信我。
Misadventure on the Sea#080.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#082.src: I'm just goin' to... Wait here... With my cannons...
Misadventure on the Sea#082.dst: 我就只是要……在这里等着……跟我的大炮一起……
Misadventure on the Sea#082.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#083.src: Talk to Honip on the deck to get your next task
Misadventure on the Sea#083.dst: 到甲板上找 Honip 领取下一个任务

Misadventure on the Sea#084.src: Hey! The boat's lookin' real nice now!
Misadventure on the Sea#084.dst: 嘿！船现在看起来真漂亮！
Misadventure on the Sea#084.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#085.src: I'll probably let you rest so- hold on.
Misadventure on the Sea#085.dst: 我大概会让你休息一下，所以——等一下。
Misadventure on the Sea#085.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#086.src: Ho-Honip! One of the guys said he saw something really weird coming right for us!
Misadventure on the Sea#086.dst: Ho、Honip！有个兄弟说他看到有个很怪的东西直直朝我们冲过来！
Misadventure on the Sea#086.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#089.src: We-we don't know! We can't exactly see it, but it seems huge!
Misadventure on the Sea#089.dst: 我、我们不知道！我们看不太清楚，但它好像很巨大！
Misadventure on the Sea#089.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#091.src: Uh... Where am I supposed to be looking at, exactly?
Misadventure on the Sea#091.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#092.src: I swear, it felt like the whole ocean was getting crazy a second ago!
Misadventure on the Sea#092.dst: 我发誓，刚才感觉整片海都发疯了！
Misadventure on the Sea#092.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#093.src: If this is another one of your jokes...
Misadventure on the Sea#093.dst: 要是这又是你们的玩笑……
Misadventure on the Sea#093.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#096.src: I don't know, this wasn't planned!
Misadventure on the Sea#096.dst: 我不知道，这可不在计划里！
Misadventure on the Sea#096.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#097.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#097.dst: 士兵，该你大显身手了！用你的法术什么的把它吓跑！
Misadventure on the Sea#097.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#102.src: I knew you had it in ya, haha!
Misadventure on the Sea#102.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#103.src: What a show! Come, I've got some things to tell ya!
Misadventure on the Sea#103.dst: 真是精彩！过来，我有些事要跟你说！
Misadventure on the Sea#103.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#104.src: I don't know where that creature came from, but thanks to you it's gone.
Misadventure on the Sea#104.dst: 我不知道那个生物是从哪里来的，但多亏了你，它走了。
Misadventure on the Sea#104.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#105.src: I've got something else for you to tackle. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#105.dst: 我还有别的事要交给你处理。是关于……那些老鼠。
Misadventure on the Sea#105.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#106.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#106.dst: 到货舱来，我边走边跟你解释。
Misadventure on the Sea#106.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#107.src: I think we have quite a hellish problem on our hands.
Misadventure on the Sea#107.dst: 我想我们手上有个非常要命的问题。
Misadventure on the Sea#107.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#108.src: I'm not sure what y'all find there, but these are NOT normal rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#108.dst: 我不确定你们会在那里找到什么，但那些绝对不是普通的老鼠。
Misadventure on the Sea#108.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#109.src: So please, get in there... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#109.dst: 所以拜托，进去……把所有东西都杀光，好吗？
Misadventure on the Sea#109.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#110.src: I've got faith in ya. Here goes nothin'!
Misadventure on the Sea#110.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#111.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#111.dst: 士兵，该你大显身手了！用你的法术什么的把它吓跑！
Misadventure on the Sea#111.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#112.src: Just cast one of your fancy spells!
Misadventure on the Sea#112.dst: 随便放个你那些花哨的法术就行！
Misadventure on the Sea#112.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#113.src: That was... Phew... That was something.
Misadventure on the Sea#113.dst: 刚才……呼……刚才可真够呛的。
Misadventure on the Sea#113.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#114.src: Now, for an even bigger surprise...
Misadventure on the Sea#114.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#115.src: What the hell soldier?? What don't you get in the "soldier" part of your job?
Misadventure on the Sea#115.dst: 搞什么啊，士兵？？你工作里“士兵”这两个字你到底哪里不懂？
Misadventure on the Sea#115.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#116.src: Come, let's figure some things out.
Misadventure on the Sea#116.dst: 过来，我们来把一些事情弄清楚。
Misadventure on the Sea#116.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#117.src: You've been a massive disappointment, y'know?
Misadventure on the Sea#117.dst: 你真是让人大失所望，你知道吗？
Misadventure on the Sea#117.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#118.src: But you can still redeem yourself.
Misadventure on the Sea#118.dst: 不过你还有机会将功赎罪。
Misadventure on the Sea#118.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#119.src: Follow me, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#119.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#120.src: I mentioned a rat problem earlier... It's, uh, not a small one.
Misadventure on the Sea#120.dst: 我之前提过老鼠问题……那个，呃，可不是小问题。
Misadventure on the Sea#120.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#121.src: We've got gunpowder to retrieve, so you're the one who's gonna clear the hold.
Misadventure on the Sea#121.dst: 我们得去拿火药，所以由你来清理货舱。
Misadventure on the Sea#121.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#122.src: So get in there... and try to kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#122.dst: 所以进去……尽量把所有东西都杀光，好吗？
Misadventure on the Sea#122.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#123.src: Don't be as bad as earlier. You're a soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#123.dst: 别像刚才那么差劲了。你可是士兵。
Misadventure on the Sea#123.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#126.src: I expected you to do somethin', soldier, not him!
Misadventure on the Sea#126.dst: 我是指望你做点什么，士兵，不是指望它！
Misadventure on the Sea#126.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#128.src: I have another task for you. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#128.dst: 我还有一个任务要给你。是关于……那些老鼠。
Misadventure on the Sea#128.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#129.src: See, I really don't think we have your usual type of problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#129.dst: 你看，我真的不认为我们遇到的是一般的问题。
Misadventure on the Sea#129.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#130.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#130.dst: 到货舱来，我边走边跟你解释。
Misadventure on the Sea#130.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#131.src: We sometimes hear unusually load footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
Misadventure on the Sea#131.dst: 我们有时会听到异常响亮的脚步声，还有一些非常诡异的吱吱声……
Misadventure on the Sea#131.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#132.src: That's why we're not too fond of goin' in... But our gunpowder there! We need it, as pirates!
Misadventure on the Sea#132.dst: 所以我们都不太想进去……可我们的火药在那里！身为海盗，我们需要它！
Misadventure on the Sea#132.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#133.src: So, I need you to get in... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#133.dst: 所以，我需要你进去……把所有东西都杀光，好吗？
Misadventure on the Sea#133.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#134.src: Here goes nothing. Snoo, ya stay there!
Misadventure on the Sea#134.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#135.src: Explore the hold and kill the rats

Misadventure on the Sea#136.src: Defeat the Colossal Rat in the hold
Misadventure on the Sea#136.dst: 击败货舱里的巨型老鼠

Misadventure on the Sea#137.src: Use the gunpowder and the fuse to activate the cannon and escape
Misadventure on the Sea#137.dst: 用火药和引信启动大炮逃走

Misadventure on the Sea#138.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#138.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#139.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#139.dst: 你解决了那些该死的偷东西的耗子？一只……巨型老鼠，你说？
Misadventure on the Sea#139.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#140.src: Nicely done, I knew I could count on ya! C'mere, take these!
Misadventure on the Sea#140.dst: 干得漂亮，我就知道能靠你！过来，拿着这些！
Misadventure on the Sea#140.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#141.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#141.dst: 总之，现在你可以去休息，想做什么都行！
Misadventure on the Sea#141.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#142.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#142.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#143.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#143.dst: 你解决了那些该死的偷东西的耗子？一只……巨型老鼠，你说？
Misadventure on the Sea#143.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#144.src: Well, shiver me timbers! You did redeem yourself soldier!
Misadventure on the Sea#144.dst: 好家伙，真是吓了我一跳！你果然将功赎罪了，士兵！
Misadventure on the Sea#144.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#145.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#145.dst: 总之，现在你可以去休息，想做什么都行！
Misadventure on the Sea#145.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#146.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#146.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#147.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#147.dst: 你解决了那些该死的偷东西的耗子？一只……巨型老鼠，你说？
Misadventure on the Sea#147.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#148.src: That sounds absolutely terrifying! And ya did that alone! You know what, her', take these.
Misadventure on the Sea#148.dst: 听起来真是太吓人了！而且你还是一个人干的！跟你说，来，拿着这些。
Misadventure on the Sea#148.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#149.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#149.dst: 总之，现在你可以去休息，想做什么都行！
Misadventure on the Sea#149.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#150.src: Hey! What do you think you're doin'?!
Misadventure on the Sea#150.speaker: Pirate Guard

Misadventure on the Sea#152.src: No, but they did a great job in the hold! Some gunpowder went missing though.
Misadventure on the Sea#152.dst: 没有，不过他们在货舱干得很好！只是少了一些火药。
Misadventure on the Sea#152.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#156.src: Find out where you are and a way to flee the island
Misadventure on the Sea#156.dst: 查明你在哪里，找到逃离小岛的办法

Misadventure on the Sea#157.src: 'ey there soldier! Looks like ya're in a bit of a pickle! How 'bout ya hop on?'
Misadventure on the Sea#157.dst: 嘿，士兵！看来你遇上麻烦了！要不要上船？
Misadventure on the Sea#157.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#158.src: Well... We're headed for {p}, the heart of the ocean! Which is safer than wherever you were, heh!
Misadventure on the Sea#158.dst: 嗯……我们要去 {p}，海洋的中心！总比你刚才待的地方安全，嘿！
Misadventure on the Sea#158.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#159.src: I was casually takin' a scenic detour when I saw you and your shiny equipment on that island.
Misadventure on the Sea#159.dst: 我正悠闲地绕路看风景，就看到你和你那身闪亮的装备在那座岛上。
Misadventure on the Sea#159.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#160.src: So, ya gotta tell me what happened!
Misadventure on the Sea#160.dst: 所以，你得告诉我发生了什么事！
Misadventure on the Sea#160.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#161.src: Oh, kidnapped by pirates I see! How unfortunate...
Misadventure on the Sea#161.dst: 噢，被海盗绑架了啊！真是不幸……
Misadventure on the Sea#161.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#162.src: I guess that'll show ya, tryin' to avoid using good ol' seaskipper! I'm the only trustworthy one 'round here.
Misadventure on the Sea#162.dst: 我想这下你学到教训了吧，谁叫你不搭我们可靠的老 Seaskipper！这一带就只有我值得信赖。
Misadventure on the Sea#162.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#163.src: Well, I hope they weren't too bad with ya! Here, I'll make you travel to {p} for free as compensation.
Misadventure on the Sea#163.dst: 嗯，希望他们没怎么为难你！来，作为补偿，我免费载你去 {p}。
Misadventure on the Sea#163.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#164.src: Anyway, I can see the shore off in the distance! Hang tight, we're almost there!
Misadventure on the Sea#164.dst: 总之，我已经看到远处的海岸了！抓稳，我们快到了！
Misadventure on the Sea#164.speaker: Seaskipper Captain
